item.title: My project blog Week 5
item.description: In my first week of starting this new project i was mainly thinking about what features my program would have. I started out making a mental model of what i wanted and then translated that flow into a domianmodel. item.title: My project blog week 3
item.description: week 3 i focused on chaniging the structure of my api reader class because i needed to make the conversation between the user and the llm interactive. I also found out that it would be smart to have a back up llm since the free gemini llm is not always reliable.
